title: console: the help menu has no 「关于」 and the console shows no build version anywhere, so a reviewer cannot tell which objectui build a tenant serves
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2928 readings. That card's Target 2 is objectui's to build. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Pull

objectstack-ai/cloud#2928 Target 2, from the 2026-10-16 walk of the test1016 tenant: the tenant console must show its version (the help menu's 「关于」), so that a reviewer can tell which build they are looking at. The walk's readings lagged objectui `main` by a whole batch, and nothing on the page said so.

## What was measured (cloud's pins: objectui `0707b4ae`, framework `be076dad28a0`; both planes, zh-CN)

- **The help menus have no 「关于」.** Control plane: 本应用文档 / 全部文档 / 键盘快捷键 / 在线文档. Tenant: 全部文档 / 在线文档 (`packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` ~L1087–1138). The account menus have none either, and no version string appears on either page.
- **The runtime config carries no version key** (`packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts` ~L287–321), so a host has nothing to serve that the console would read.
- **`VITE_APP_VERSION` is read only as a Sentry release fallback** (`packages/app-shell/src/observability/sentry.ts` ~L219). Cloud's Dockerfiles build the console with no `VITE_` variable.

## Wanted

- A 「关于」 item in the help menu that names the console's own build: the objectui commit baked in at build time, using `VITE_APP_VERSION` (the existing spelling), with a git fallback for local builds.
- Optionally, beside it, the runtime's build identity (cloud serves `x-objectstack-build-sha` on `/api/v1/health`).

Cloud's half is then one build-arg per Dockerfile passing `.objectui-sha`. It is owed only once objectui reads it: a key with no reader would declare what the runtime does not honour.

## Acceptance

- A test: the help menu shows 「关于」, and the dialog names the baked commit. Built without one, it shows a stated fallback, not an empty field.
- A screenshot from a console built with `VITE_APP_VERSION` set.

## Dedupe

300 objectui issues (open and closed, by last update) scanned for 「关于」, "about dialog", `VITE_APP_VERSION` and "build version": none carries this.
